data.name: Druid
targeting_extra: Vine Crush ability follows Druid target priority
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Hard Thorns
1.text: Thorn pierce 1->2; thorns, thorn piles, vine zones become Normal damage (hit Lead and Frozen).

1.name: Heart of Thunder
1.text: Extra lightning attack: jumps through obstacles, splits into up to 2 forks within 86 units each hit (up to 31 targets). Pierce not buffable; cannot damage Purple.

1.name: Druid of the Storm
1.text: Tornado seeks targets, blows bloons back 100-200 units, 0 damage, pierce 35 (2 per Ceramic). Not MOAB-class, not White/Purple if undamageable; removes glue and freeze. Tiny Tornadoes MK: splits into 3 mini tornadoes (pierce 5, blowback 33-300, not Lead/MOAB).

1.name: Ball Lightning
1.text: Camo detection. Slow lightning ball every 6s, zaps lightning every 0.35s (3 dmg, forks 5), no damage itself, freezes non-White 4.5s through up to 4 layers. Heart of Thunder lightning 2->3 dmg. Tornado blowback +50 (150-250), pierce 35->60, no Ceramic penalty.

1.name: Monarch of Storms
1.text: Superstorm: slow projectile, 100 dmg, pierce 200, rehit 1s, ignores walls, bounces off map borders, blowback on MOAB-class, can target BADs not Bosses, fires a ball lightning every 3s in random direction within 180 deg; removes glue/ice (except BAD/Boss glue). Triggers every 4s. Heart of Thunder 3->30, ball lightning bolts 3->10.

2.name: Thorn Swarm
2.text: 8 thorns per shot instead of 5, same angular spread.

2.name: Heart of Oak
2.text: All attacks remove Regrow from bloons they damage. +1% pierce per life above life count at purchase, max +100%.

2.name: Druid of the Jungle
2.text: Vine grabs and kills one bloon anywhere on screen (not MOAB-class, not Camo), leaving a thorn pile on the track; vine digests then cooldown. With Hard Thorns can grab Lead/Frozen. Druidic Reach: pile duration +33%. Obyn Lv5+: +40% range for Druids of the Jungle.

2.name: Jungle's Bounty
2.text: Vine Crush ability: crushes 10 bloons by Druid target priority, cd 30s, initial 10s, needs a valid bloon on screen. Piles stronger (see stats). End of round: $120 + per-farm bonus for farms in range (+$10/20/40/60/120 by highest tier), +1 life; cash capped $10,000, buffable by Monkey City and Obyn Lv5+. Range 35->45 (this tier gives +10 as listed in wiki).

2.name: Spirit of the Forest
2.text: Thick vine zone on track near Druid grows 3 units/s; 3 stacked layers (all range: 2 dmg +8 Ceramic/MOAB; within 100: +1 dmg +4; within 50: +1 dmg +14; totals 4 dmg and 30 bonus at center), ticks every 0.5s. End-of-round $1,120 base plus farm bonus, +25 lives. Thorns deal 6 damage. Vine Crush pierce 20 and leaves thorn piles. Vine Rupture ability only with Vine Rupture MK: explosions 150 dmg, pierce 60, stun 7s regular / 3s MOAB-class, cd 60s.

3.name: Heart of Vengeance
3.text: +10% attack speed, +1% per life lost since purchase, max +50%; diminishes if lives regained.

3.name: Druid of Wrath
3.text: +5% attack speed per 10 damage dealt, stacks to 20 (+100%); resets at round end or after 2s without dealing damage. Obyn Lv18+: Druids of Wrath start each round with max wrath.

3.name: Poplust
3.text: +15% attack speed and pierce to all other Druids in range, stacks additively up to 5 times (+75%). Excludes itself.

3.name: Avatar of Wrath
3.text: +5 range, +3 damage, attack speed x2 (cooldown 0.55s); +1 damage per 3,000 leak damage (not RBE) on screen, max +30, also applies to Heart of Thunder lightning, which also gains double speed.

paragon.name: Root of all Nature
paragon.requirement: Monarch of Storms, Spirit of the Forest and Avatar of Wrath on map at once; absorbs other Druids; degree 1-100.
paragon.effect: Electrified thorns ricochet between bloons (Normal damage); attack speed ramps while attacking (like Druid of Wrath). Prevents Regrow regeneration map-wide and deals massive damage to Regrow. End of round, on BAD pop, or Boss Skull defeat: cash scaled by Banana Farms on map plus 1 life. Base damage of all attacks scales with player cash. Passive sentient forest on track (stronger near paragon). Periodically throws a seed to grow storm trees (Vinenado blowback, count as Banana Farms). Ability Primordial Wrath: toggle - more damage, drains cash over time and stops other towers generating cash. Special interaction buffing Obyn Greenfoot. Exact numbers not captured.
